resources.string: Face Unlock works with most glasses and sunglasses, but might not recognize you if you’re wearing something that covers your face
Your phone can be unlocked by someone else if you’re not looking directly at it
Require your eyes to be open and looking at the phone to unlock it
Face Unlock uses the front camera to scan your face. It works best in a well-lit place, holding the phone at eye level and a normal arm’s length away.
You can remove your face data at any time in Settings. Face Unlock is used only to unlock your phone and authorize actions you approve.
